name: Belmont High School Climate Action Club
description: Student club at Belmont High School that runs a lunchtime composting program and pushes for less waste across Belmont schools.

name: Boston Latin School Youth Climate Action Network
description: After-school climate club at Boston Latin School that runs a youth climate summit, campaigns for sustainability education in grades 7-12 and coordinates a network of youth climate groups at other Massachusetts schools.

name: Massachusetts Coalition for Occupational Safety and Health Teens Lead at Work
description: Youth program of MassCOSH that trains Boston teens as peer educators and organizers on workplace rights and safety, with a goal of building young labor and environmental justice activists.

events.name: Celebrating the Movement: 50 Years of MassCOSH

projects: East Boston Cambria Hotel asbestos campaign
actions: Sign the Cambria Hotel asbestos petition

name: Massachusetts Public Interest Research Group Boston
Massachusetts Climate Action Network
description: Network that supports local climate action town by town through local chapters, working with 40+ communities on decarbonization and electrification and advocating on state energy and climate policy.

projects: Make Polluters Pay - Massachusetts Climate Superfund
actions: Petition: pass the Make Polluters Pay bill
Write your legislators: 350 Mass priority bills

name: Conservation Law Foundation
description: New England environmental advocacy group, founded in 1966 and headquartered in Boston, that uses law, science and policy on clean energy, clean air and water, oceans and environmental justice.

actions: Tell your state representatives to invest in climate-ready infrastructure
Pledge to protect Boston Harbor and the public waterfront
Ask legislators to ban single-use plastic

Add your name to support CLF's litigation against polluters

name: The Climate Reality Project Massachusetts Southcoast
description: Southcoast chapter of The Climate Reality Project, founded in late 2019, that does public outreach, education and advocacy on climate and partners with local businesses and nonprofits on renewable energy pledges.

name: First Parish in Concord  Environmental Team
description: Environmental action team of the First Parish in Concord Unitarian Universalist congregation that leads its sustainability, environmental worship and education, and environmental justice efforts under the UUA Green Sanctuary program.

name: Longmeadow Pipeline Awareness Group
description: Longmeadow residents' group that opposes Eversource's proposed high-pressure gas pipeline and meter station in Longmeadow and Springfield, working with the Springfield Climate Justice Coalition.

name: Passive House Massachusetts
description: Member-based nonprofit that promotes the Passive House building standard through education, training, events and advocacy to cut building energy use and carbon emissions.

events.name: Simplifying Passive House Multifamily Certification with Tomás O'Leary
2026 Passive House Symposium: Moving the Market

projects: Passive House Massachusetts Training and Resources

name: Solstice Initiative
description: Cambridge-based clean energy company that connects households and businesses to community solar and runs a community benefit fund that channels money to solar projects in underserved communities.

actions: Enroll in community solar with Solstice

name: Watertown Citizens for Peace, Justice, and the Environment
description: Watertown group founded in 1979 that works on local environmental protection (Charles River cleanup, chemical-free garden tours), peace and social justice.

name: American Federation of Teachers Massachusetts
description: State federation of the American Federation of Teachers, representing about 25,000 teachers, public employees, higher-ed faculty and health professionals in Massachusetts.

actions: Email legislators to support educator pay legislation

name: Collaborative for High Performance Schools
description: Membership organization that runs a green building rating program for K-12 schools (CHPS Designed and CHPS Verified) and publishes best-practice guidance and training.

name: Massachusetts Teachers Association Climate Action Network
description: Network of over 160 Massachusetts Teachers Association members that backs student climate strikes, writes green contract language, builds climate curriculum and partners with environmental and labor groups.

name: 350Vermont
description: Statewide grassroots climate group based in Burlington, described by partners as the primary driver of Vermont's Climate Superfund Act.

name: Vermont Community Thermal Networks
description: Statewide group advancing community-led thermal energy networks (shared ground-source heat loops) and coordinating with Vermont organizations to scale them.

name: Trust for Public Land (Vermont)
description: Vermont office of the national land conservation nonprofit, at 3 Shipman Place in Montpelier; works on protected land and community forests.

name: Shelburne Farms
description: Shelburne-based nonprofit listed among Energy Action Network's nonprofit members.

name: Vermont Passive House
description: Montpelier-based group promoting Passive House building; an Energy Action Network member.

name: Citizens' Climate Lobby - University of Vermont
description: Student chapter of Citizens' Climate Lobby at the University of Vermont, started in April 2023 and listed as active; it meets on Mondays at 7 pm in Aiken Hall.

name: Center for Sustainable Energy
description: Clean-energy nonprofit that runs incentive programs, advisory services and policy research on clean transportation and the built environment.

name: Regulatory Assistance Project
description: Nonprofit that advises regulators and policymakers on clean-electricity, grid and electrification policy; its US home office is in Montpelier.

name: Vermont Land Trust
description: Statewide land conservation nonprofit that works with farmers, woodland owners and communities to protect land, and hosts public events and workshops.

events.name: Winter Preview: How and Where to Recreate This Winter

name: Bristol Energy Committee
description: Town committee in Bristol that meets monthly; the town lists agendas, minutes and video for its 2025 and 2026 meetings.

name: Huntington Energy Committee
description: Selectboard-appointed committee that promotes energy savings through conservation, efficiency and renewables, supports home weatherization through the Energy Navigators program and is updating the energy section of the Town Plan.

name: Earth Matters Manchester
description: Southern Vermont climate-justice group and 350Vermont node that raises awareness of climate change and ways to reduce its effects; it is the environmental committee of MoveOn Manchester.

name: Rural Environmental Justice Opportunities Informed by Community Expertise (REJOICE)
description: Coalition project that held 19 community conversations across Vermont from 2017 to 2021 and whose findings informed the state's 2022 environmental justice law.
